tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind everything: marketing pages, the app shell, the area around dashboard cards.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, toasts, chart panels.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card (shadcn --card-foreground). Same value as foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Surface of popovers, menus and select lists (shadcn --popover). Same value as card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, secondary buttons, the tabs track, skeleton blocks, menu highlight.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (shadcn --secondary).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. 7.8:1 in dark, 10.0:1 in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard highlight in menus, lists and ghost buttons (shadcn --accent).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent. 9.9:1 in dark, 15.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, separators, table rules, chart gridlines. Decorative (1.3:1 on card in both themes).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: inputs, textareas, select triggers, unchecked checkboxes and radios, the switch track when off. In this palette it is a hairline like border: 1.3:1 on card in both themes, below the 3:1 a control edge needs. Kept as supplied; flagged.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline (2px solid, 2px offset) and the hovered/focused input border. 3.6:1 on card and 3.7:1 on background in dark; 2.6:1 and 2.4:1 in light, below 3:1 (kept as supplied; flagged).

tokens.name: ring-halo
tokens.usage: The soft 3px halo around a focused input, outside its ring-coloured border. Decorative; the border carries the contrast.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, card and muted. 14.9:1 on card in dark, 16.9:1 in light.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on background, card and muted: descriptions, metadata, axis labels, placeholders. 5.2:1 on card in dark, 5.1:1 in light; 4.5:1 on muted in dark, 4.6:1 in light.

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks only: chart axis lines, disabled icons, the empty-state glyph. Not for text (4.5:1 on card in dark, 2.8:1 on card in light).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view and checked controls (checkbox, radio, switch). The accent is ink, not a hue.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover (base-vega's primary/80, flattened).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: the primary button label, the check glyph, the switch thumb when on. 14.2:1 on primary in dark, 17.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Fill inside inputs, textareas, selects and unchecked checkboxes (base-vega's input/30 in dark).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy state and positive deltas (conversion up, goal met), always beside an icon and a sign. Text on card: 9.1:1 dark, 7.0:1 light; 7.9:1 and 6.0:1 on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: sampling active, quota near, tracking delayed. Always with an icon. Text on card: 10.1:1 dark, 6.3:1 light; 8.6:1 and 5.4:1 on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, negative deltas, destructive actions; always with an icon or sign. Text on card: 4.1:1 dark, 4.5:1 light, so dark is below 4.5:1 (kept as supplied; flagged). 3.1:1 on danger-soft in dark, 4.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text in alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text in alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and the tint behind danger text: danger at 10%.

tokens.name: danger-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button on hover; invalid input halo: danger at 20%.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (shadcn --destructive-foreground): white in both themes. 4.2:1 on danger in dark, below 4.5:1 (kept as supplied; flagged); 4.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series slot 1, the lightest step of a five-step blue ramp, the same in both themes: the headline series, e.g. Visitors or Revenue. Steps differ in lightness, so the ramp suits ordered or ranked series. Lines 2px, bars 4px-rounded ends. 10.7:1 on card in dark; 1.8:1 in light, below the 3:1 a mark needs (flagged): use it for fills there, not thin lines.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series slot 2: the comparison series, e.g. Previous period or Pageviews. 5.2:1 on card in dark, 3.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series slot 3. Assign slots in order, never cycled; a series keeps its slot when filters hide others. 3.8:1 on card in dark, 5.0:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series slot 4. Lines and bars only; scatter and maps stop at three series. 2.9:1 on card in dark, below 3:1 (flagged); 6.6:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series slot 5, the darkest step. A sixth series folds into Other. 2.2:1 on card in dark, below 3:1 (flagged); 8.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The folded Other series, and the unselected bars of a highlight.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar surface.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the sidebar. 15.0:1 on sidebar in dark, 12.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: The active item or primary action in the sidebar: blue in dark, ink in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary. 6.5:1 in dark, 17.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected sidebar items.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent. 12.9:1 in dark, 13.3:1 in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Hairline between the sidebar and the page, and between sidebar groups. Decorative.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside the sidebar. 2.2:1 on sidebar in dark, 1.9:1 in light, both below 3:1 (kept as supplied; flagged).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per marketing page: the hero line.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: App page titles: Overview, Journeys, Funnels, Revenue.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The headline number in a KPI card. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tally follows each visitor from first touch to paid order.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sessions from organic search rose 12% this week.
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, tab triggers, alert titles.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button, menu item and badge labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above section titles and KPI labels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: URLs, UTM strings, event names, IDs in tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in badges; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; label to input.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Alert vertical padding; gap inside a card footer.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Popover and toast padding; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between card groups on a dashboard.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section padding in the app.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Section padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, menu items, chart bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, popovers, tooltips, menus, toasts, tab triggers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tabs track, alerts, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, radio dots, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: a 1px foreground/10 ring instead of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, select lists, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The active tab trigger.
